profile.headline: Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer at Collins Aerospace

positions.title: Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer (Software)
positions.locationName: Wilson, North Carolina, United States · On-site

positions.title: Lead Test Manufacturing Engineering Technician
positions.description:
Ensured successful completion of assigned projects within budgeted time constraints.

Provided technical assistance and resolution when development mechanical or electrical problems are encountered.

Participated as a team member assisting  in product design, development and production

Assembled mechanical or electrical systems and prototypes according to engineering data, using hand tools and measuring instruments.

Build, set up and disassemble equipment including prototypes, test articles and test fixtures.

Troubleshoot sample system installations providing solutions to technical problems.

Modified prototypes, parts, assemblies and systems to correct functional deviations.

Analyzed and interpret test information to resolve design related problems.

Collaborated with engineers and other personnel to identify, define and solve development problems.

Install operating system and all required drivers and software for production equipment.

Utilize computer-aided design and drafting equipment to assist during design and development phase
    
Performed other related duties as required.

positions.title: Process Technician 2
positions.description:
Lead ground vehicle Production Process Technician, 

Performs a variety of duties on Optical-Electrical Electronic Sensors,

Develops build processes and assists in design of complex optical and electronic assemblies

Performs testing, trouble-shooting and evaluation of assemblies

Works with engineering in the development of new and existing applications of technology

Modify, repair, and reworks complex assemblies as per "IPC" standards.

Works from engineering documentation, production documentation, drawings and schematics. 

Operates Automated and Manual test equipment for evaluation and functional test purposes of product,

Conducts tests reports data in documented required format

Often provides technical insight to other Technicians and Engineers including mentoring and training others. 

Work with Quality engineering on "ACE" Standards to improve production yields.

Develop Access and Excel databases to monitor production yields, Quality Issues and Efficiency rates to  eliminate production Waste.

positions.title: Production Tech
positions.description:
Evaluated, repaired and restored customer required hardware data and video from RMA units. 

Processed incoming customer RMA DVR systems Using "SYSPRO" for internal Tracking and inventory.

Developed work instructions for processing and evaluating RMA units and the steps required for data entry into "SysPro"

Recovered critical customer video and data from failed DVR systems.

Repair and maintain production equipment at manufacturing facility.

Quality Test and upgrade factory production units.

Used "Track Ticket System" to track Software failures, Bug reports, and software support issues with returned units for quick engineering evaluation.

Traveled to local contract manufacture to maintain, repair, or setup test equipment to meet  production goals.

Assist shipping , receiving and inventory processing using "Crystal Reports".

positions.title: Production Tech 3
positions.description:
Responsible for the technical support operations in a high-volume production environment.

This included Defect evaluation, Debug and Rework on the Fly. 

Performed Fiber Optic splicing on Single mode, Multi-mode and Erbium doped fiber.

Performed Laser tuning of JDSU and FITEL Laser-diodes for Customer ASE and power requirements. 

Performed Functional Test Debug repair and Final setup on Deep Packet Inspection Modules (DPIMS) as per Customer requirements.

Performed Debugging of failed product down to the component level using schematics, Assembly Drawings, Digital multimeters, milliohm meters, oscilloscopes, Function Generators, Digital Signal Processors and other evaluation equipment.

Performed Functional automated Testing and bench testing using Lab-View test software,Teradyne/GenRad ICT machines, and X-Ray PWB/BGA inspection.

Key Contributions:

In 2002 i was sent to a customer site in Israel for further training and helped to solve quality and performance issues with a product.
